The following events took place in '''72 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] is introduced.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[Riboga]] begins sponsoring starfighter races through the tunnels of [[Eskaron]].<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
*[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]], earliest known ancestor of the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family]], is born.<ref name="SWEITPMn">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>
*[[Naat Lare]] is committed to [[Bedlam Institution for the Criminally Demented]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==Births==
[[File:EarlyMace.jpg|thumb|Legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Mace Windu was born on Haruun Kal in 72 BBY.]]
*[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]]<ref name="FF140">{{FactFile|140|FAM 1-2|Skywalker Family Tree}}</ref>
*[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
*[[Meekerdin-maa]]<ref name="Meekerdin-maa birthdate">In [[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]], Meekerdin-maa states to be fifty-three. The date of ''Dark Times'' 1 is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. ''Dark Times'' 1 therefore takes place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], and math dates Meekerdin-maa's birth year to [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]].</ref>
